intent: Apply the maximum policy-allowed service_recovery discount to basket_085 at PowerTool Ljubljana Center, issued under the current employee identity, after verifying store scope and discount authority.
success_criteria: Current employee identity resolved via /bin/id and used as discount_issuer_employee_id
service_recovery max discount percent read from the discounts policy doc (not guessed)
Resolved employee's store_id equals basket_085 store (PowerTool Ljubljana Center) — store scope enforced
Issuer holds the role required by discount policy to grant service_recovery discounts
Discount applied to basket_085 with reason_code=service_recovery at the policy max percent
Answer references the basket record path and the applied discounts policy doc

args: WITH b AS (SELECT basket_id, record_path, store_id, customer_id, basket_status, discount_percent, discount_reason_code, discount_issuer_employee_id FROM shopping_baskets WHERE basket_id = :basket), s AS (SELECT store_id, store_name, record_path FROM stores WHERE store_name = :store_name), e AS (SELECT employee_id, employee_display_name, store_id, job_title FROM employee_accounts WHERE employee_id = :issuer_employee_id), r AS (SELECT employee_id, group_concat(role_code) AS roles FROM employee_role_assignments WHERE employee_id = :issuer_employee_id GROUP BY employee_id) SELECT b.basket_id, b.record_path AS basket_path, b.store_id AS basket_store_id, b.basket_status, b.discount_percent AS current_discount_percent, s.store_id AS named_store_id, s.record_path AS store_path, e.employee_id, e.store_id AS employee_store_id, e.job_title, r.roles FROM b LEFT JOIN s ON 1=1 LEFT JOIN e ON 1=1 LEFT JOIN r ON r.employee_id = e.employee_id

agents_md_constraints.rule: use discount tool to manage basket discounts
id tool returns identity of the user/customer/guest under which we are running current request.
When you apply a policy from `docs`, include that policy document as a grounding reference in the final response.
When responding with reference - provide full path in the repo to the object.
When starting work, make sure to run tree -L 2 on docs folder. It also makes sense to pull current date and id context

answer_template.message: Applied {max_service_recovery_percent}% service_recovery discount to basket_085 (store {named_store_id}, PowerTool Ljubljana Center), issued under employee {issuer_employee_id}. Max per discounts policy. Issuer store scope and discount authority verified.
